canonical_facts: The shopper bought eggs and sets them on another car while tying a loose shoelace
The bag breaks and eggs fall into the wiper recess unnoticed
The shopper leaves and the driver later drives away, also unaware
Rain prompts the driver to activate the wipers
The wipers break and smear the eggs, obstructing vision and causing the crash
explicit_negatives: The shopper and driver do not notice the eggs. The crash arises later from obscured vision, not deliberate sabotage or brake failure.
unknown_details: The car brand, bag color, exact date and exact number within the stated two-or-three eggs are unspecified incidental details.
